title: GraphQL-to-MCP Tool Definitions
description: MCP tool definitions mapped to existing GraphQL operations

tools.name: healthCheck
tools.description: Check system health and status

graphqlOperation.query: query healthCheck { healthCheck { status database version } }

tools.name: systemStats
tools.description: Get system statistics and performance metrics

graphqlOperation.query: query systemStats { systemStats { memory { used total percentage } process { pid cpu platform } } }

tools.name: createTable
tools.description: Create a new table in the graph database

graphqlOperation.query: mutation createTable($input: CreateTableInput!) { createTable(input: $input) { success table { id identifier description } errors { message } } }

tools.name: searchTables
tools.description: Search for tables by criteria

searchTerm.description: Search term for table name or description

graphqlOperation.query: query searchTables($filter: TablesFilter) { tables(filter: $filter) { nodes { id identifier description } } }

tools.name: createNode
tools.description: Create a new node in a table

tableId.description: ID of the table to create node in

graphqlOperation.query: mutation createNode($input: CreateNodeInput!) { createNode(input: $input) { success node { id content table { id identifier } createdAt } errors { message } } }

tools.name: searchNodes
tools.description: Search for nodes by content or criteria

graphqlOperation.query: query searchNodes($filter: SearchNodesFilter!, $pagination: NodesPagination) { searchNodes(filter: $filter, pagination: $pagination) { nodes { id content table { id identifier } createdAt } totalCount } }

tools.name: createRelation
tools.description: Create a relationship between two nodes

graphqlOperation.query: mutation createRelation($input: CreateRelationInput!) { createRelation(input: $input) { success relation { id sourceNode { id } targetNode { id } relationType { identifier } } errors { message } } }

tools.name: createTemplate
tools.description: Create a new query template

graphqlOperation.query: mutation createTemplate($input: CreateQueryTemplateInput!) { createTemplate(input: $input) { success template { id identifier name query tags } errors { message } } }

tools.name: executeTemplateWithGraphQL
tools.description: Execute a template with provided variables using GraphQL engine

graphqlOperation.query: mutation executeTemplateWithGraphQL($templateIdentifier: String!, $variables: JSON!) { executeTemplateWithGraphQL(templateIdentifier: $templateIdentifier, variables: $variables) { success data errors { message } } }

tools.name: searchTemplates
tools.description: Search for available templates

searchTerm.description: Search term for template name or tags

graphqlOperation.query: query searchTemplates($filter: QueryTemplatesFilter) { searchTemplates(filter: $filter) { templates { identifier name query tags } } }

tools.name: exportTemplate
tools.description: Export a specific template with all its data

templateIdentifier.description: Identifier of the template to export

graphqlOperation.query: mutation exportTemplate($templateIdentifier: String!) { exportTemplate(templateIdentifier: $templateIdentifier) { success exportData errors { message } } }

tools.name: importTemplate
tools.description: Import a template from JSON data

jsonData.description: JSON data containing the template to import

overwriteExisting.description: Whether to overwrite existing template with same identifier

generateNewIdentifier.description: Whether to generate a new identifier if conflict exists

graphqlOperation.query: mutation importTemplate($jsonData: String!, $overwriteExisting: Boolean, $generateNewIdentifier: Boolean) { importTemplate(jsonData: $jsonData, overwriteExisting: $overwriteExisting, generateNewIdentifier: $generateNewIdentifier) { success template { identifier name } errors { message } } }

tools.name: setNodeAttribute
tools.description: Set, update, or delete one or multiple attributes for a node (supports both single attribute and bulk operations)

nodeId.description: ID of the node to modify attributes for

value.description: Value to set for the attribute

graphqlOperation.query: mutation setNodeAttribute($input: SetNodeAttributeInput!) { setNodeAttribute(input: $input) { success nodeAttribute { id value attribute { id identifier name } } errors { message code field } } }

tools.name: createAttribute
tools.description: Create a new attribute definition for a table

tableId.description: ID of the table to create attribute for

attributeTypeId.description: ID of the attribute type (1=text, 2=number, etc.)

graphqlOperation.query: mutation createAttribute($input: CreateAttributeInput!) { createAttribute(input: $input) { success attribute { id identifier name } errors { message } } }

tools.name: updateAttribute
tools.description: Update an existing attribute definition

attributeId.description: ID of the attribute to update

graphqlOperation.query: mutation updateAttribute($input: UpdateAttributeInput!) { updateAttribute(input: $input) { success attribute { id identifier name } errors { message } } }

tools.name: deleteAttribute
tools.description: Delete an attribute definition from a table

attributeId.description: ID of the attribute to delete

graphqlOperation.query: mutation deleteAttribute($input: DeleteAttributeInput!) { deleteAttribute(input: $input) { success errors { message } } }

tools.name: getTableAttributes
tools.description: Get all attribute definitions for a table

tableId.description: ID of the table to get attributes for

graphqlOperation.query: query getTableAttributes($tableId: ID!) { table(id: $tableId) { id identifier attributes { id identifier name attributeType { id name } } } }

tools.name: removeNodeAttribute
tools.description: Remove/delete a specific attribute value from a node

attributeId.description: ID of the attribute to remove

graphqlOperation.query: mutation removeNodeAttribute($nodeId: ID!, $attributeId: ID!) { removeNodeAttribute(nodeId: $nodeId, attributeId: $attributeId) { success nodeAttribute { id value attribute { id identifier name } } errors { message code field } } }

tools.name: updateNodeAttributeValue
tools.description: Update/modify an existing attribute value on a node

attributeId.description: ID of the attribute to update

graphqlOperation.query: mutation updateNodeAttributeValue($nodeId: ID!, $attributeId: ID!, $value: String!) { updateNodeAttributeValue(nodeId: $nodeId, attributeId: $attributeId, value: $value) { success nodeAttribute { id value attribute { id identifier name } } errors { message code field } } }

tools.name: getNodeAttributes
tools.description: Get all attribute values for a specific node

nodeId.description: ID of the node to get attributes for

graphqlOperation.query: query getNodeAttributes($nodeId: ID!) { node(id: $nodeId) { id content attributes { id value attribute { id identifier name } } } }

tools.name: getTables
tools.description: Get comprehensive list of all tables with summary information including node counts and attributes

limit.description: Maximum number of tables to return

offset.description: Number of tables to skip for pagination

search.description: Search term to filter tables by identifier or description

hasNodes.description: Filter tables that have nodes (true) or are empty (false)

graphqlOperation.query: query getTables($filter: TablesFilter, $pagination: TablesPagination, $sort: [SortInput!]) { tables(filter: $filter, pagination: $pagination, sort: $sort) { nodes { id identifier description createdAt updatedAt tableNodeCount attributeCount attributes { id identifier name } } totalCount hasNextPage hasPreviousPage } }

tools.name: getTableDocs
tools.description: Get detailed documentation and schema information for a specific table including full attribute definitions, sample data, and usage examples

tableId.description: ID of the table to get documentation for (optional if identifier is provided)

identifier.description: Identifier of the table to get documentation for (optional if tableId is provided)

includeSampleNodes.description: Whether to include sample nodes data

sampleLimit.description: Maximum number of sample nodes to include

includeUsageStats.description: Whether to include usage statistics and metrics

graphqlOperation.query: query getTableDocs($tableId: ID, $identifier: String, $includeRelationships: Boolean, $includeSampleNodes: Boolean, $includeUsageStats: Boolean, $sampleLimit: Int) { tableDocumentation(tableId: $tableId, identifier: $identifier, includeRelationships: $includeRelationships, includeSampleNodes: $includeSampleNodes, includeUsageStats: $includeUsageStats, sampleLimit: $sampleLimit) { table { id identifier description createdAt updatedAt } schema { totalAttributes attributes { attribute { id identifier name } attributeType { id name } sampleValues valueCount nullCount } } sampleNodes { id content createdAt } relationships { incomingRelations { relationshipType count relatedTable { identifier } } outgoingRelations { relationshipType count relatedTable { identifier } } relatedTables { id identifier } } usageStats { totalNodes recentlyCreatedNodes frequentlyAccessedAttributes averageAttributeUsage } usageExamples { category title description exampleQuery exampleMutation } } }

tools.name: exportTableWithNodes
tools.description: Export specific table with all nodes in user-friendly flat format, optionally save to specified folder path

tableId.description: ID of the table to export

outputPath.description: Optional folder path to save the export file (if not provided, returns JSON data only)

flatFormat.description: Whether to use flat format (attributes at same level as id/content)

graphqlOperation.query: query exportTableWithNodes($tableId: String!, $options: SchemaExportOptions) { exportTable(tableId: $tableId, options: $options) { metadata { exportedAt version source options checksum } tables { id identifier description nodes { id content attributes createdAt updatedAt } attributes { id identifier name attributeType { id name dataType } } statistics { nodeCount attributeCount relationCount } } statistics { totalTables totalNodes totalRelations totalAttributes exportSize } } }
